title: Bounded Queue, Drop-Oldest
prompt: Implement `BoundedQueue` with drop-oldest policy: full push drops the oldest (counted in `dropped()`), pop is `optional`, and the counters stay exact under interleavings.

tests.name: policy + counter battery
tests.hint: std::deque<std::string> storage. push: if size == capacity, pop_front and ++dropped_. dropped_ is a member counter — it never resets.
